title: addon-info causes a 'TypeError: "paddingLeft" is read-only' error on React 16
body:
We just changed our project's structure to share code between web and React Native, which currently means using React 16.0.0-alpha.12 (due to RN version 0.47). This cased the error in the title to appear in the component view where we use the info addon. Upgrading to 16.0.0-rc.3 doesn't make a difference, but downgrading to 15.6.1 removes it.

Like it says, the error comes from the Node component, specifically where left padding is added to `containerStyle`. Disabling that line removes the error.
```
function Node(props) {
  [...]
  var leftPad = {
    paddingLeft: 3 + (depth + 1) * 15,
    paddingRight: 3
  };
  // Error at below line
  (0, _assign2.default)(containerStyle, leftPad);
  [...]
```
Said line in the source: https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/blob/72186a4f32cd3ee6496d1dd89b7175948eed6c39/addons/info/src/components/Node.js#L61
